name: Xen
self_text: I’m Xen, a 40‑something Italian who loves to explore the skies—both in birdwatching and in Skyforge Arena. I enjoy casual matches where I can adapt to any role, chatting only through text. I’m on PC, never coaching, and I’m free to play Saturday mornings. If you’re up for a relaxed, flexible gaming session, let’s connect!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into casual matches, you must be available Saturday morning, and you have to be into Skyforge Arena; you must also be flexible about your role or you must play a support role. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on text chat, though it's not a requirement.
